WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, o.login_state, o.member_key o_mk, (m.member_key IS NOT NULL) mem_ok
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
 WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22')

FROM l GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_period, f.channel_id, o.login_state,
 count(*) lines, sum(case when f.member_key is null then 1 else 0 end) line_null,
 sum(case when o.member_key is null then 0 else 1 end) o_mem_lines,
 sum(f.net_amount) net,
 sum(case when o.member_key is not null then f.net_amount else 0 end) net_o_mem,
 sum(case when f.member_key is not null then f.net_amount else 0 end) net_l_mem
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) mth, f.channel_id, count(*) lines, sum(case when f.member_key is null and o.member_key is not null then 1 else 0 end) lost, sum(case when o.member_key is not null then 1 else 0 end) o_mem
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH r AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_period, (o.member_key IS NOT NULL) is_member, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(case when r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22' then r.refund_net else 0 end) refund_in_window,
   min(r.return_date) mn, max(r.return_date) mx
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT * FROM r ORDER BY ALL

SELECT d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, count(distinct f.receipt_id) orders, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct,
  sum(f.net_amount) AS web_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS line_level_member_net,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS naive_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = f.channel_id AND c.channel_group = 'web'
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
